Are al the{{ls}}e and {{ls}}uch like, Papi{{ls}}tical tran{{ls}}lations, becau{{ls}}e {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Heb. 11.''}}they are mo{{ls}}t plaine for the Catholike faith which they call Papi{{ls}}trie? La{{ls}}tly, are the auncient fathers, General Councels, the Churches of al the we{{ls}}t part, that v{{ls}}e al the{{ls}}e {{ls}}peaches & phra{{ls}}es now {{ls}}o many hundred yeres, are they al Papi{{ls}}tical?
